headline: Three more labs accept government safety tests — Conquerors falls
body: The safety story firmed up. Microsoft, Google DeepMind and xAI agreed to give NIST's Center for AI Standards and Innovation early access to frontier models for national-security testing, joining OpenAI and Anthropic. Real outside checks strengthen Alignment & Control, which lifts Protector God and Gatekeeper and pushes Conquerors and Zookeeper down. The jobs picture darkened: Coinbase cut about 700 roles and PayPal plans to cut about 20% of staff over two to three years, both citing AI. That weakens Shared Prosperity. Major publishers also sued Meta over training Llama on pirated books, adding to Tech Backlash and Reversion. Horizon Balance rose to +2.09, up 0.68, the best day of the period.
movers_note: Protector God +0.6, Conquerors -0.6 and Gatekeeper +0.5, all mainly from the NIST pre-release testing agreements (+0.56, -0.56 and +0.48).
